How It Works

Four Steps to Your Prize

Getting started is simple. Complete these steps and you're on your way to winning exclusive Apple rewards.

Open Account

Register

Open a live account with WINPROFX. New clients can opt in from their very first deposit.

Opt In

Choose the Trade to Win program and select your target reward tier before you start trading.

Trade

Trade eligible instruments — hold each trade for at least 3 minutes for it to count as a qualifying lot.

Win Your Prize

Reach your target lot volume within 30 days and claim your exclusive reward.

Program Period

When Does the Program Run?

Active Dates

The program runs from March 1, 2025 through May 31, 2026. Join at any point during this window.

Trading Timeline

Once you opt in, you have 30 days from your start date to reach your chosen target volume and claim your reward.

Opt-In Deadline

New clients can opt in starting from their very first deposit. Don't wait — every day counts toward your 30-day window.

Eligibility

Who Can Participate?

Review the eligibility requirements before joining the Trade to Win program.

Who Can Join

Exclusively for retail clients. Introducing Brokers (IBs) are excluded and cannot participate in this campaign.

Single Entry

Each participant can only join one program activity at a time. Choose your tier wisely before opting in.

Withdrawals Allowed

Withdrawals are permitted throughout the campaign and will not disqualify you from the program.

Trade Duration

Eligible trades must be held open for at least 3min to count as a qualifying lot toward your target.

Excluded Instruments

Stocks and cryptocurrency pairs are not eligible for this promotion. All other supported instruments qualify.

Account Type

Only self-directed individual accounts can participate. Managed accounts or accounts referred by IBs are not eligible.

Important Terms

Program Terms & Conditions

Please read these terms carefully before participating in the Trade to Win program.

Fair Play

Any signs of market abuse such as latency arbitrage or manipulative trading techniques will result in immediate disqualification from the program.

Dispute Resolution

Any issues not directly addressed in these terms will be handled by management in a fair and binding manner. Management's decision is final.

Liability Disclaimer

WINPROFX will not be held responsible for any trading losses incurred. This program does not alter participants' risk profiles or investment strategies.

General Terms

WINPROFX reserves the right to amend or terminate this program at any time. All existing terms and conditions of WINPROFX apply in addition to these program-specific conditions.
